_note: 空间观测台 PICO 头显 3D 资产批量清单：由 Tripo 文生 3D（text-to-model）生成，5000 积分≈200 个模型，本清单 11 个；明天积分到账后直接编辑本条与 items 再跑 scripts/tripo_asset_gen.py --manifest spatial/assets/models/manifest.json --out-dir <目录>。切勿写入任何真实 API Key/账号（Key 只走环境变量 TRIPO_API_KEY）。

items.name: moon
items.prompt: a photorealistic 3D model of the Moon as a full sphere, gray cratered surface with dark maria and bright highlands, seamless 4k PBR albedo and normal textures

items.name: mars
items.prompt: a photorealistic Mars globe, rust-red rocky surface with polar ice caps, Valles Marineris canyon and Olympus Mons volcano, 4k PBR albedo and normal textures

items.name: jupiter
items.prompt: a gas giant Jupiter sphere with swirling cream and orange cloud bands, the Great Red Spot storm, subtle atmospheric haze, 4k PBR textures

items.name: saturn
items.prompt: the ringed planet Saturn, pale gold banded atmosphere, broad flat icy rings with visible gaps, tilted ring plane, 4k PBR textures

items.name: beidou
items.prompt: the Big Dipper constellation as a set of seven faceted blue-white crystal star spheres on a thin dark connecting frame, glowing emissive material, PBR

items.name: orion

items.name: ground-station-antenna
items.prompt: a ground station parabolic dish antenna on a concrete pedestal, steel lattice mount, feed horn on a tripod, cable runs, weathered industrial PBR metal and concrete

items.name: shortwave-radio

items.name: weather-satellite

items.name: cubesat

items.name: space-telescope
